description: Sealed geared guitar tuning machine (Grover Rotomatic 102 class) as a five-part assembly with its real gear train: die-cast housing, string post, worm WHEEL on the post (tooth count = catalog ratio, 14:1 Grover / 16:1 Gotoh), the tuning button whose key shaft carries the single-start WORM, and the separate peghole bushing.
source: Grover Rotomatic 102 + Gotoh SG381 dimensioned drawings (post/bushing/housing/mount); gear ratios: grotro.com (102 series 14:1), g-gotoh.com (SG381 1:16); proportion for housing depth and key shaft
